value.text:
The University of Sorocaba (Universidade de Sorocaba, Uniso) is a private, nonprofit community university in Sorocaba, in the Brazilian state of São Paulo. It has a regional orientation and is described as non-confessional. Maintained by Fundação Dom Aguirre, the university is affiliated with the Associação Brasileira das Instituições Comunitárias de Educação Superior. Its teaching locations include the Trujillo campus and Cidade Universitária Professor Aldo Vannucchi.

The university’s history is connected to the Faculdade de Filosofia, Ciências e Letras de Sorocaba, which originated in 1951. That institution began operating on 7 March 1954 with programmes in pedagogy and Neo-Latin languages. The university phase dates to 15 September 1994; this milestone is distinct from the predecessor’s earlier origin. The diversification of the predecessor’s courses also led to the Faculdade de Administração e Ciências Contábeis de Sorocaba.

Uniso offers undergraduate education and postgraduate study. Its master’s and doctoral programmes include pharmaceutical sciences, communication and culture, education, and technological and environmental processes. Research and teaching are supported by laboratories, while extension programmes address areas including health, education, culture and the environment. The Uniso Tech technology park, created in 2021, supports collaboration with businesses in Sorocaba and the surrounding region.
